# Bundled dependencies

Bundled unchanged to make offline preparation independent of external CDNs.

- Phaser 3.80.1: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/phaser@3.80.1/dist/phaser.min.js
  — MIT, see `PHASER-LICENSE.md`.
- DotGothic16 Regular: https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/dotgothic16
  — SIL Open Font License 1.1, see `DotGothic16-OFL.txt`.

Retrieved 2026-10-04. The project's geometric wizard/book icons are original
artwork reproducible with `../generate-icons.html`.
